detail.title: Dahua Access ANPR Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite ITC413-PW4D Series Dahua Access ANPR Camera Key Points • 120+ countries license plate recognition with high accuracy ≥ 98% (EU) & 96% (others) • See better: 4MP, F1.4/F1.6 mega-aperture captures 99%+ of vehicles in any light conditions • Safer & Secure: Instantly spot unauthorized vehicles and identify critical details like vehicle brand, color, license status. • Auto-Sync Parking Access: Remote controller for easier operation, unified I/O control for barriers & electric gates, wiegand interface for access control integration. • Auto-Threat Alert: Tri-Sensor defense (light+siren+speaker) for site-wide security. • Deployment-Ready: camera, bracket, junction box in one. Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Camera.Max. Detection Speed: DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z1, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ1:80 km/h DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z3, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ3:120 km/h
Camera.Min. Illumination: DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z1,DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ1: 0.0004 Lux@F1.4 (Color, 30 IRE); 0.0001 Lux@F1.4 (B/W, 30 IRE); 0 Lux (Illuminator on) DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z3,DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ3: 0.001 Lux@F1.6 (Color, 30 IRE); 0.0002 Lux@F1.6 (B/W, 30 IRE); 0 Lux (Illuminator on)
Camera.Focal Length: DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z1, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ1: 2.7 mm–12 mm DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z3, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ3: 8 mm–32 mm

Illuminator.Illuminator Type: DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ1, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ3:IR (850 nm) DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z1, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z3:Dual Illuminators (730 nm IR/warm light)
Illuminator.Illumination Distance: DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z1, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ1: ANPR: 10 m (32.81 ft) Video monitoring: 30 m (98.43 ft) DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z3, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ3: ANPR: 30 m (98.43 ft) Video monitoring: 60 m (196.85 ft)
Illuminator.Smart Illumination: According to the brightness of the environment, the camera automatically adjusts the intensity of its light to reveal the details of moving targets. Devices with warm light can automatically adjust the light intensity according to the time.
Illuminator.Infrared Wavelength: DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ1, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ3:850 nm DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z1, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z3:730 nm

Video.Video Compression: H.264H; H.264B; H.264M by default; H.265; MJPEG; H.264M
Video.Image Tampering Prevention: Yes. Watermarks can be added to videos and images. The watermark can also be verified.
Video.Storage: Bult-in TF card port. Supports Kingston 16 G, 32 G, 128 G, 256 G; Dahua card 16 G, 32 G, 128 G, 256 G; SanDisk 16 G, 32 G, 128 G, 256 G
Video.IVS: Intrusion detection, loitering detection, up to 4 areas can be set.
Video.Basic Event: Alarms for events of defocus, no storage card, storage card no space, storage card error, network disconnection, IP conflict, and illegal access.
Video.Sound and Light Alarm: Yes, blue & red indicator, and supports broadcasting custom audio.
Video.Alarm Linkage: Upload to FTP/Memory card, notify monitoring center, send e-mail, trigger alert output, snapshot and active deterrence
Video.Capture Distance: DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z1, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ1: 3 m–8 m (9.84 ft–26.25 ft) DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z3, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ3: 8 m–30 m (26.25 ft–98.43 ft)
Video.Detected Width: DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z1, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ1: 3 m–4 m (9.84 ft–13.12 ft) DHI-ITC413-PW4D-Z3, DHI-ITC413-PW4D-IZ3: 6 m–8 m (19.69 ft–26.25 ft)
Video.Network Protocol: HTTP; Https; 802.1x; TCP; ARP; RTSP; RTP; UDP; RTCP; SMTP; FTP; DHCP; DNS; IPv4/v6; NTP; SFTP;DDNS; SNMP; PPPoE
Video.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S/Profile T/Profile M); CGI; ITSAPI; P2P
Video.Management Software: DSS Pro; DSS Express; Cybercity; Smart PSS;DMSS
Video.Security: Username and password; MAC address; HTTPS; IEEE 802.1x; network access control
Video.Browser: Plug in: IE 9, 10, 11. Chrome 52 and earlier versions Firefox 42 and earlier versions No plug in: Chrome 92 and later versions
Video.Image Setting: Brightness; contrast; saturation; gamma; sharpness; gain; white balance
Video.Day/Night: IR filter, support three modes: color/B/W/auto
Video.White Balance: Auto; Regional Custom; Manual; Outdoor; Natural; Street Lamp
Video.OSD Overlay: Supports overlay of time; address (position of channel), lane (number/direction), plate (number and color), vehicle (color, type)
Video.Built-in MIC: Yes; Pick-up distance: 3 m (9.84 ft), Sampling Rate: 48 k.
Video.Alarm Input: 2, optocoupler input (wet node on-off value: 5 V)
Video.Alarm Output: 2, relay output (2A 30 VDC/0.5A 125 VAC), which can connect to devices such as barriers
Video.AI Recognition: Recognizes vehicle types, vehicle signs, vehicle color, vehicle plate, plate, vehicle without plate.
Video.Video Metadata: Displays the intelligent frame, plate and vehicle paths.
Video.Vehicle Color: Recognizes 12 colors: Grey, black, white, silver, blue, green, purple, red, orange, pink, brown, and yellow.
Video.Vehicle Type Recognition: Recognizes 10 vehicle types: Large Bus, Heavy Truck, Medium Truck, Sedan, Van, Light Truck, Medium Bus, SUV, MPV, Pickup
Video.Country and Region Supported by ANPR: Baseline support: 10 options (85 countries) General: Supports universal characters GCC (U.A.E., Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Oman, Iraq, Egypt, Jordan, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Lebanon) South Africa: South Africa, Tanzania, Mozambique, Zambia, Uganda, Equatorial Guinea, Mauritius, Kenya South Asia Region (India Region) : India, Maldives Europe (Netherlands, France, Germany, Britain, Italy, Poland, Belgium, Bulgaria, Serbia, Slovakia, Spain, Denmark, Turkey, Israel, Czech Republic, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Switzerland, Austria, Hungary, Romania, Lithuania, Latvia, Sweden, Estonia, Portugal, Greece, Slovenia, Luxembourg, Palestine, Lebanon, Ireland, Finland, Norway, Croatia, North Macedonia) South American Economies Collection (Uruguay, Paraguay, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, Guyana, Bolivia ) Mexico and other countries: Mexico, Costa Rica, Curacao, Guatemala Eurasian Collection (Russia, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Moldova, Georgia, Azerbaijan, Turkmenistan) North America (United States, Canada) North Africa Region Collection: Tunisia, Morocco, Algeria, Libya The baseline algorithm is supported for the following 19 countries: Republic of Korea, Indonesia, Singapore, Cambodia, Australia, Thailand, Bassett, Nigeria, Pakistan, Viet Nam, Mongolia, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Philippines, Laos, Iraq, Japan, Maldives, Nepal
Video.Capture Rate: In the recommended installation and lighting condition, the vehicle capture rate ≥ 99%
Video.Recognition Rate: In the recommended installation and lighting condition, the recognition rate for positive and departing vehicles≥ 96%; the recognition rate for European vehicle plates ≥ 98%
Video.Remote Control Distance: 15 m (49.21 ft) (In an open, undisturbed environment)
Video.Power Supply: 12 VDC, 2 A and POE:802.3at,Type 2,Class 4,(44V to 57V), 0.455A to 0.351A,max.20W
Video.Power Consumption: Power consumption in different conditions: No lighting < 6 W Lighting <12 W Speaker and Red/Blue Light Warning on < 17 W
